summary: Iteration 158: Complete testing of Dynamic Referidor Field feature. All 8 backend tests passed. Frontend UI verified - two-level referidor selector (Tipo + dynamic secondary field) working correctly with all 4 options: Banco (30 banks), Cliente Existente (315+ clients with search), Otro (free text), Ninguno (hidden secondary).
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/clients/referidor-options returns 30+ banks and 315+ clients correctly
POST /api/clients with referidor_tipo=BANCO/CLIENTE/OTRO creates clients with correct referidor fields
GET /api/clients/{id} returns referidor_tipo, referidor_id, referidor_nombre fields
GET /api/clients/template has 'Referidor Tipo' and 'Referidor Identificador' columns
POST /api/clients/import validates referidor_tipo BANCO/CLIENTE/OTRO with cross-reference validation
Frontend 'Datos de Captación' section visible in client form
Frontend dynamic selector: BANCO→bank dropdown, CLIENTE→searchable client dropdown, OTRO→free text, NINGUNO→hidden
Edit client form pre-loads referidor fields correctly
seed_data_creation: Test clients created and cleaned up during tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Dynamic Referidor feature fully implemented. The client form has a two-level selector: 'Tipo de Referidor' (BANCO/CLIENTE/OTRO/Ninguno) and a dynamic secondary field that changes based on selection. Banks are fetched from /api/clients/referidor-options (30 banks), clients are searchable (315+ clients). Import template updated with 'Referidor Tipo' and 'Referidor Identificador' columns with validation.
